{{Top}}
[[File:BattleOfFelucia-Night.png|thumb|250px|The Felucian landscape was full of bright colors.]]
{{Quote|The use of Imperial Scarlet predominated, with gold, silver, blue and green accenting various features. Just when the clash of color would become too much, we'd walk past an alcove or a wall panel that housed artwork from one of the myriad planets in the galaxy.|[[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]]|<ref name="I, Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>}}
'''Colors''' were visual properties that derived from the light [[Spectrum/Legends|spectrum]]. Colors were often culturally significant in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Color symbolism in the Republic and Imperial societies==
===[[Red]]===
In the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], red was prominently displayed as a symbol of [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] affiliation and so many ambassadorial [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] were painted red. Any [[Consular ship/Legends|consular ship]] hailing directly from [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] was colored red all over its hull, while others would only bear stripes in that hue.<ref name="ICSI">''[[Star Wars: Episode I Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> Under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], some of those habits were kept in use, for what was called "Republic red" followed the teaching of seemingly co-opting the republican traditions. Red [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] were favored by [[Darksider|dark-siders]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], including [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="Book of Sith">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> The Emperor personally favored the color scarlet as it featured prominently on the family crest of [[House Palpatine/Legends|House Palpatine]].<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> His preference for several variations of the color red, including crimson and burgundy, were reflected through the interior design of his [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|private apartments]], as well as the uniforms of the [[Red Guard]]<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref> and their [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Imperial successors]].<ref name="RotJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

Because it was the color of [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Blood/Legends|blood]], red was also associated with murder.<ref name="MFMY">''[[Mission from Mount Yoda]]''</ref> Crimson, a shade of red, was a traditional signifier of [[King/Legends|royal]] authority.<ref name="FF29 2014">{{FactFile2014|29|GAR 1-4|Naboo Royal Garments}}</ref> Similarly, members of the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] traditionally wore a particular shade of red, called the [[Color of war/Legends|color of war]], while fighting. For this reason, Chagrians serving in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War typically wore red accent pieces on their uniforms.<ref name="Lead by Example">''[[Lead by Example]]''</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], like most other colors, red was also used as an indicator of rank among clone forces within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]: In particular, red was used to indicate those holding the rank of either [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] or [[Major/Legends|Major]].<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

===[[Orange]]===
On [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], orange and red vestments symbolized rebirth and renewal.<ref name="FF29 2014" />

===[[Yellow]]===
The color yellow was associated with lies in Imperial culture. When the [[mutant]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Trioculus]] met the fake [[Supreme Prophet]] of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark Side]], the pseudo-[[Rajah Ubooki|Kadann]], he told him he was the son of the late [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. The fake Kadann then crushed a yellow chalk ball in his hand, meaning he did not believe Trioculus' claim.<ref name="MFMY" /> In the days of the Old Republic, [[Jedi Sentinel/Legends|Jedi Sentinels]] and members in the [[Eternal Empire]] often owned yellow-bladed lightsabers.<ref name="TJP" /> During the Clone Wars, like most other colors, yellow was also used as an indicator of rank among clone forces within the Grand Army of the Republic: In particular, yellow was used to indicate those holding various ranks of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]], in particular battalion commander, regimental commander, [[Senior Commander/Legends|senior commander]], and marshal commander.<ref name="EGTW" />

===[[Green (disambiguation)|Green]]===
As green was the color of most [[Plant/Legends|plant]] life,<ref name="C&S">''[[Star Wars Adventures in Colors and Shapes]]''</ref> it was generally perceived in a positive light, and was a symbol of life and youth. Lush planets were commonly described as "green" (such as [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] or the [[Green Coruscant]]). At the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], green was adopted by the [[Corellian Jedi]] to show their devotion to the ancient flag of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> They began to wear emerald robes, and this tradition lasted until the time of [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]].<ref name="I, Jedi" /> Additionally, [[Jedi Consular]]s often used green-bladed lightsabers to symbolize their commitment to peace.<ref name="TJP" /> During the Clone Wars, like most other colors, various shades of green were also used as an indicator of rank among clone forces within the Grand Army of the Republic: In particular, the standard shade was used to represent [[Sergeant major/Legends|Sergeant-Major]], while olive green was used to represent [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]].<ref name="EGTW" />

Despite the color's general positive connotations, one who was inexperienced at something, such as a raw recruit in the military, was sometimes said to be "green."<ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>

===[[Blue]]===
Blue was associated with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|chancellorship]] in the waning days of the Republic. Chancellor [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] Palpatine would often don blue coats or robes to express their interest in leading the Republic.<ref name="EPI:VD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> In the old [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], a blue-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] was traditionally associated with the [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardians]], whose talents lay in martial skills.<ref name="TJP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> Despite its previous positive associations, blue was the color of shame and disgrace in the late Imperial culture.<ref name="PoDS">[[Prophets of the Dark Side (novel)|''Prophets of the Dark Side'']]</ref> During the Clone Wars, like most other colors, blue was also used as an indicator of rank among clone forces within the Grand Army of the Republic: In particular, blue was used to indicate those holding the rank of either [[Second Lieutenant/Legends|Second Lieutenant]] or [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]].<ref name="EGTW" />

===[[Purple (disambiguation)|Violet]]===
Violet (colloquially purple) was the only shade that had never been historically associated with war, anger or mourning in any civilization within the Republic. For that reason, the interior of the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] was painted in lavender shade.<ref name="EPI:VD" /> Purple is the signature color of [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu's]] [[Mace Windu's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].

===[[Black]]===
Black was generally associated with night and darkness, as well as with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. The color "Sith black" was considered a symbol of their ancient dread.<ref name="DSD">''[[Death Star Designer]]''</ref> In the culture of the Galactic Empire, black was considered a symbol of victory.<ref name="MFMY" />

===[[Gray]]===
A light medium gray was the traditional hue the Empire chose for its [[Starship/Legends|ships]] and stations.<ref name="DSD" /> The aim was to make the Imperial presence recognizable at glance, and to instill fear by insisting on the weapons' power and not on their appearance. Though some distinctive unit markings did exist, they still were marginal.<ref name="SWMBC">''[[Star Wars Miniatures Battles Companion]]''</ref>

===[[White]]===
While the color white was associated with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by some (such as the the [[White Current/Legends|White Current]] of the [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]]), it was also chosen by the Empire for its elite force of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. Their full anonymous armor was chosen by designers who knew that what people couldn't see was more terrifying than what the Empire could do.<ref name="DSD" /><ref name="SWMBC" /> For the full paint job of large spaceship, "Star Destroyer White" was the only industrial shade of paint that was available at reasonable prices.<ref name="I, Jedi" /> Sheets of [[Paper/Legends|paper]] were usually white, and so was the fur of creatures such as the [[Hoojib/Legends|Hoojibs]] of [[Arbra/Legends|Arbra]] and the [[Wampa/Legends|Wampas]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="C&S" />

==Ultraviolet colors==
Some species (like the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] or the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]]) could view more colors than others, notably light in the [[Ultraviolet/Legends|ultraviolet]]. Such extra colors included [[Berl (color)|berl]], [[crynor]], [[nusp]], and [[onsible]].<ref name="MedstarII">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>

==Colors as a language==
The reptilian [[Tarasin]] from [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] used to express their ideas or emotions through a complex system of skin color changes. For example, their light green skin changing to purple indicated amusement. Though much of their [[Tarasin Skintone Language]] could not express complex thoughts, the changing colors of the skin could give basic directions without speech while the Tarasin were hunting or attempting to evade the massive [[kilassin]] that roamed the jungles of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="Shades of Meaning">''{{Wizards|url=rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf20011011a_shades&c=swlfc|text=Shades of Meaning}}''</ref>

Similarly, the skull feathers of the [[Bird/Legends|avian]] [[Fosh/Legends|Fosh]] would shift color depending on their mood.<ref name="Traitor">''[[The New Jedi Order: Traitor]]''</ref> Green indicated inquisitiveness, thoughtfulness or amusement; orange was a sign of happiness; and gray reflected anger, disgust, irritation or seriousness.

In the [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] [[Gree (language)|language]], colors were used in conjunction with geometric shapes to make expression patterns. It seems that color-related terms mostly filled function.<ref name="TOR" />
